name: Pi Zero 2W + SSD1683 3.7" 416x240 Mono EPD (PID 6395) Demo
description: Drives the Adafruit 3.7" 416x240 monochrome E-Ink bare display (PID 6395) on the Pi e-Ink Bonnet, on a Pi Zero 2W running the host build. The panel is the ThinkInk_370_Mono_BAAMFGN (UC8253 silicon) which the host SSD1683 driver covers via its mono path (mode=EPD_MODE_MONO, no grayscale LUT). Pin map matches Blinka's BCM-keyed Dxx aliases (CS=CE0/D8, DC=D22, RST=D27, BUSY=D17). seconds_per_frame is pinned to 5s on the host driver; the 12s step delays clear that cooldown with room for a human to read each frame.

steps.name: checkin-response
steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and Pi-bonnet-shaped capabilities.

steps.name: add-display
steps.description: Add the SSD1683-driven 3.7" 416x240 mono EPD over SPI bus 0 with the bonnet's fixed pin map. Initial blank refresh runs as part of Add.

steps.name: write-hello
steps.description: First message after the initial blank refresh.

steps.name: write-step2
steps.description: Second message; 12s gap clears the 5s refresh cooldown.

steps.name: write-removing
steps.description: Final message before the display is removed.

steps.name: remove-display
steps.description: Tear down the display so a future Add can re-init the bus cleanly.
